newsitem.title: USA: Paramount names Goldwyn president, pictures.
newsitem.headline: Paramount names Goldwyn president, pictures.

text.p: John Goldwyn was promoted to the newly created position of president of Viacom Inc's Paramount Motion Pictures, Paramount said.
For the past six years, Goldwyn was president, Motion Picture Group/Production, overseeing the development and production of Paramount's motion pictures.
Goldwyn's grandfather was Hollywood producer Samuel Goldwyn who formed a company with Cecil B. DeMille and Jesse L. Lasky that became part of Paramount Pictures.
His father Samuel Goldwyn Jr is chairman and chief executive officer of Samuel Goldwyn Co, a unit of Metromedia International Group Inc.
